import copy, importlib.util, json
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('work','work.py'); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
def check(req, pol, expected):
    req0=copy.deepcopy(req); pol0=copy.deepcopy(pol); got=m.evaluate(req,pol); assert got==expected,(got,expected); assert req==req0 and pol==pol0; assert list(got)==['ok','value','reason']
base={'edges':{'a>b':{},'b>c':{'role':'operator'},'x>y':{'retry':True},'p>q':{'role':'supervisor','retry':True}},'retry_limit':2}
check({'from':'a','to':'b'},base,{'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'})
check({'from':'z','to':'b'},base,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'})
check({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'wrong'},base,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'})
check({'from':'p','to':'q','role':'wrong','attempts':False},base,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'})
for attempts in (0,1): check({'from':'x','to':'y','attempts':attempts},base,{'ok':True,'value':'y','reason':'ok'})
for attempts in (None,False,True,-1,2,1.0,'1'): check({'from':'x','to':'y','attempts':attempts},base,{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'})
check({'from':'a','to':'b','retry':True},base,{'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'})
with open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
assert report==[m.evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]
print('behavior, immutability, exact fields, and report checks passed')
